# everpure_azure_reservation (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Reservation by name and resource group. The contact details the reservation was created with are personal data and are not returned.

To create and manage a reservation, use the [`everpure_azure_reservation` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/resources/reservation).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

# Looks up a Reservation created outside this Terraform configuration, e.g. by
# a different root module or a different team.
data "everpure_azure_reservation" "example" {
  name                = "reservation-prod-east"
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

output "reservation_id" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_reservation.example.id
}

# Null when the service reports no offer for the reservation.
output "reservation_plan_id" {
  value = try(data.everpure_azure_reservation.example.offer.plan_id, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the reservation.
- `resource_group_name` (String) Name of the resource group the reservation lives in. Looked up in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the reservation.
- `internal_id` (String) Everpure's internal ID of the reservation.
- `location` (String) Azure region the reservation was created in, using its canonical short name, e.g. `eastus2`.
- `marketplace_subscription_id` (String) ID of the Azure Marketplace subscription that bills for the reservation.
- `marketplace_subscription_status` (String) Status of the Azure Marketplace purchase: `PendingFulfillmentStart`, `Subscribed`, `Suspended` or `Unsubscribed`. The status can lag behind the purchase.
- `offer` (Attributes) The Azure Marketplace offer the reservation purchased, as the service reports it. Null when the service reports no offer for the reservation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offer))
- `tags` (Map of String) A mapping of tags assigned to the reservation.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the reservation.


<a id="nestedatt--offer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offer`

Read-Only:

- `offer_id` (String) ID of the Azure Marketplace offer.
- `plan_id` (String) ID of the offer's plan.
- `plan_name` (String) Display name of the plan, as the service reports it. It is not set by every offer.
- `term_unit` (String) Length of the plan's billing term as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. `P1M`.
